examples.text: Nun war die Aktion von Samidoun, die nach dem Überfall auf Israel in Neukölln Süßigkeiten verteilten und die Hamas abfeierten, nicht unbequem, sondern strafbar.
examples.translation: Now, Samidoun actions – handing out sweets and celebrating Hamas in Neukölln after the attack on Israel – were not only uncomfortable but punishable under the law.
examples.english: Now, Samidoun actions – handing out sweets and celebrating Hamas in Neukölln after the attack on Israel – were not only uncomfortable but punishable under the law.
